title: Points of interest
limitations: Proposed 2026-11-09: five POIs curated by an agent from NASA Curiosity mission blog posts for the story lead's review. Positions are the rover's PDS PLACES localized_interp.csv position at the sol of the cited image (a localized solution also present in localized_pos.csv), not surveyed positions of the features. position_uncertainty_m is 0.5, the PLACES SIS 1.3 Rev-A §4.4.1.2 expected accuracy of localized rover positions against the HiRISE base map; it excludes the offset between the rover and the imaged feature. Stop types and ez_theme labels are team framing (assumed); the resource framing of the sulfate contact has no NASA water-yield figure behind it. Image files are saved by hand and not committed. Vector resolution values of 0 mean not applicable under C5.
